scope: Read-only source review of migration from the actual ResearchPanel to the local Upgrades prototype

issues.finding: With SHOW_SELECTED_PROJECT false, ordinary clicks outside queue-picking mode update hidden inspection state and expose no Start/Cancel action.
issues.recommendation: Choose a visible, usable default card action without restoring the removed detail panel.

issues.finding: Manually enabling a bot upgrade switches away from the active queue; disabling a selected project pauses queued work until explicit resume. This interaction has no visible explanation in the compact upgrade control.
issues.recommendation: Make the interruption/resume policy legible and review how the Upgrade toggle cooperates with the queue.

issues.finding: Extra Map Point is listed, but the specimen cannot choose a destination. Queue attempts require an existing destination quote in destination-priced worlds; the hidden detail panel contains the ordinary map-navigation action.
issues.recommendation: Connect the card to Node Map destination selection and retain exact target/price across queueing, switching and loading.

issues.finding: The compact Upgrade control describes enabling collection and shows Core payments, while the next-recipe benefit is in the hidden project description. Other project benefits/prerequisites rely largely on hover tooltips while details are hidden.
issues.recommendation: Expose effects and requirements through keyboard/touch-accessible inspection and completion feedback while preserving the reviewed compact layout.

issues.finding: Hint eligibility history and assignment acknowledgement live in component state and reset with remount/reload. The shared selector still follows the old research progression and has no finalBotUpgrade branch; after Final Core production it prioritizes victory. Existing Dwarven Tribute guidance remains documented as inconsistent with new-world guarded deposits.
issues.recommendation: Persist eligible/read history per campaign and review guidance against the shifted character-upgrade meanings, including Final upgrade and versioned world rules.

issues.finding: The actual app still mounts ResearchPanel with allowedProjectId, focusProjectId and map/recipe callbacks. The standalone prototype does not accept those interfaces. Tutorial copy directs users to Start Assembler research, Completed Research and Basic Core research.
issues.recommendation: Carry guided restrictions, highlighting, focus, recipe returns and map callbacks into the integrated modal and rewrite affected tutorial steps.

issues.status: unverified transition coverage, not a proven save-loss bug
issues.finding: The preview overlays the global catalog locally, reuses next-Core project IDs and adds finalBotUpgrade. Queue/pause save round trips are covered, but adoption of character tiers across real old campaigns is still pending.
issues.recommendation: Move proposal rules into supported game content and verify existing completions, paid/active projects, tier inference, quotes, load/undo/mod catalog changes and the agreed separation of Final character upgrade from victory.

limits: No gameplay/source changes applied. No fresh browser, test suite or normal-play run; source-confirmed behavior and unverified integration checks are labeled separately. Recommendations remain proposals.
